test: add failing tests for Story 23-1 unified plugin SDK core

RED phase: 105 tests across 6 SDK crates (23 failing, 82 passing).

- PluginId::FromStr parsing and validation (AC-4)
- PluginKind::Display lowercase snake_case format (AC-5)
- PluginManifest::validate_config JSON Schema validation (AC-3)

Also fixes pre-existing test quality issues in axiathon-core:
- Rename time-ordering tests to reflect non-decreasing semantics
- Rename clone test to clone_preserves_values
- Delete 5 tautological error propagation/Result alias tests
- Fix NotFound assertion to check both fields (AND not OR)
- Add TenantContext empty-fields edge case
- Add ApiResponse dual-state test
EOF
)"","description":"Commit RED phase tests"}
